𝗢𝗯𝗷𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲
The objective is to outperform the MSCI World index over the long term.

𝐁𝐈𝐎 & 𝐄𝐗𝐏𝐄𝐑𝐈𝐄𝐍𝐂𝐄: My name is Christian Jain Kongsted, and I am a Danish investor with 15+ years of investing experience and a long track record of beating the market.

I am also a four times Danish Champion in Scrabble, and a former elite chess player (ELO: 2280). I love games and numbers.

I am looking for companies that can grow 10X in medium to long term and have a runway that gives also a chance of a 100X return in the longer term. I have been an eToro Top 2 most copied Popular Investor in USA continuously since 2020. I have a passion for the future of Bitcoin and the companies that are able to outperform Bitcoin by increasing the Bitcoin per share.

I bought my first stock when I was 12 years old,. In those days a stock was a physical piece of paper.

In October 1997 I invested in Yahoo! In 1999 I invested in Amazon.

When Google had been online for less than 4.5 months in January 1999 and had 10 employees I wrote to the email at the bottom of their homepage and asked if I could invest in the company. I got an email back saying that they had just received funding, but that he would let him know of any future opportunities. That "he" was Sergey Brin the Co-Founder of Google. Unfortunately I never heard back, but I did invest in them once they went public in 2005.

Now I focus on Bitcoin and Bitcoin treasury companies, as I believe that this will be the biggest value growth for years to come.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: I invest in Bitcoin & Bitcoin proxies. Focus on long term (min 3-5 years) value creation.

I’m Ocean, a Malaysia-based investor with 13 years in the local market and 10 years in US stocks, including 8 years on eToro.

My approach is simple: buy good businesses, understand what I own, and give them time to grow. I focus on fundamentals, valuation and long-term growth potential, with a typical holding period of 2–5 years.

Market corrections don't scare me. If the investment thesis remains intact, I see weakness as an opportunity to add gradually. I keep cash ready for these situations rather than chasing the market.

No borrowed capital. No short selling. No shortcuts.

I have a Computer Science degree, previously ran my own computer business, and now work as a Life Planning Advisor. I also hold the CISI Capital Markets Programme / International Certificate in Wealth and Investment Management.

I don't promise quick gains. I invest with patience, discipline and a long-term mindset.

Minimum copy: $1000 | Suggested: $10,000+

Note to new copiers — please read before copying.

Rules
1. No stock leverage.
2. Concentrated; single names can be large.
3. A small sleeve may include smaller-cap stocks.
4. New copiers: USD 3,000+ mirrors better; 10,000+ tracks closer. Smaller copies track worse. Existing smaller copies are not asked to leave.
5. Horizon: 2–3 years, not weekly trading. Size can still change a lot when conditions change.

Strategy
Rotates among energy/cash-flow hedges, Japan value (major sogo shosha), and selective AI-tech when risk-reward allows. Cash/defensives rise when markets look extended. I do not forecast every move. In unstable markets I may add or cut in large steps. Material rebalances get a separate post.

Risk
I can accept ~30% drawdown. If you cannot hold that, do not copy. Avoid a tight Copy Stop Loss (5–10%); it closes the copy in normal volatility.

Concentrated, unlevered, multi-year. Not for beating Nasdaq every month. A few hundred dollars can copy but will not track well.
Thanks.

* To manage risks, I limit allocation to individual stocks to 5% and secure profits when positions grow beyond allocation. I also reduce volatility.

* To beat the markets, I diversify investments 40% in large-cap, 50% in mid-cap and 10% in high risk high growth small-cap.

- Long term time horizon
- Focused on low risk, high reward
- Patience to take advantage of market irrationality
- Always investing with a margin of safety
- Aiming for 15%+ annual long-term returns

decision-making

Hi，大家好，我是好葉。
100萬訂閱投資理財YouTuber

Q: 好葉怎麼投資？
A: 在eToro上我只用x1的槓桿買股票做長期投資，因為不需要任何手續費。

Q: 那你如何選股呢？
A: 我選股主要看三樣東西
1，趨勢 （未來3到5年的趨勢有哪些，我就會研究相關行業的公司）
2，財務健康（同時也會針對這些公司過去的財務狀況進行分析後才入手）
3，時間點（很多人都想要低買高賣，但沒有人知道什麼時候是低，是什麼時候是高，所以我喜歡在股市崩盤的時候大手購入，因為趨勢不可擋，好的股票總會回盈）

Q: 如何實現和你一樣的投資組合？
A: 在我的頁面點擊右上方藍色“複製”按鈕，輸入跟單金額即可（打√）

Q: 跟你單ROI有多少？
A: 我努力每年保持至少10%~20%的回報率。

Q: 建議複製跟單你多少金額？
A: 最低200，建議1000以上以完全複製到我投資的全部股票。

Q: 要複製跟單你多久呢？
A: 建議至少1年以上，因為我是投資這些股票3到5年的前景。短期的波動，我不為所動~
--

I'm BetterLeaf
Financial YouTuber with 900k subscribers.

Q: How do you choose stock?
A: Base on 3 things:
1, Trends (What trends is going on in nest 3 to 5 years, then I’ll study the related industries)

2, Finance Health (Deeply investigate those companies before buying their stock)

3, Timing (Most people want to buy Low sell High, but nobody knows when is High or when is Low. So I prefer to buy in bulk when the market crash, because trend cannot be stopped and a good stock will always triumph)

Recommended Copy Amount: 1000
userDetails.aboutMeShort:
成長 + 價值投資策略
專注挑選有3-5年增長前景的成長型公司，
研究公司的護城河，包括品牌價值、利潤空間、網絡效應、門檻優勢，
然後計算合理的估值，以合理的價格買入優秀的公司。

I work full-time as an IT professional. I am also an active investor who studied and passed all 3 CFA levels in 2018. Key takeaways are asset allocation and portfolio management in practices. Most importantly, it's to have rules and goals in life-long investment journey.

Rule #1. Never lose money.
Rule #2. Never forget rule #1.

My SMART goals to succeed 
1. Specific - Long positions on stocks and ETF with *1 leverage and zero overnight fee

3. Attainable - Buy the dips of great businesses and diversify the portfolio
4. Relative - Invest in businesses that I can financially understand and that have proven successful business models
5. Time - is my friend. I don't speculate or expect quick wins

Welcome to my investment profile!

My name is Gustavo, and I'm a long-term value investor focused on compounding capital while managing downside risk.

My approach follows a core-satellite strategy, combining a defensively tilted core of high-quality businesses with a flexible allocation to growth and value opportunities. When market volatility makes leading companies more attractively valued, I redeploy capital from the defensive core to capitalize on these mispricings. This structure is designed to protect capital and navigate full market cycles, while staying ready to act when exceptional opportunities arise.

I hold a Bachelor's degree in Financial Management and have completed the CISI Level 3 Certificate in Wealth & Investment Management.

This portfolio is engineered for investors seeking long-term growth with a focus on drawdown protection.

My strategy is developed from live trading, as my experience with backtesting is that it often fail in the live markets. The companies are picked based on a detailed analysis of fundamental signs and long term technical signs. To be included in my portfolio, the company has to both be traded at an acceptable price and have momentum. When i buy a company, I do look 12 months forward. I am an investor/position trader. I do believe in "let the good companies get room to grow".

My portfolio will be well diversified into different sectors. I never use gearing/leverage. This portfolio will only contain stocks

⏳ Duration
I use a buy-and-hold strategy, meaning profits take time to grow. I recommend copying for at least 2 years. The longer you stay invested, the better the potential results.

💰 Investment Strategy
My strategy focuses on long-term growth and regular dividends, rather than short-term volatility. 𝗕𝗶𝗼
Former CPA fascinated with economy and figures, now creating reporting softwares for listed companies. I successfully invest my own money for 8 years on stocks, indexes, and derivatives. I am graduate of CISI3.

𝗧𝗮𝗿𝗴𝗲𝘁
I am a mid and long term indice trader, targeting a 20% absolute performance per year, no matter the market conditions or the indices overall variations.

𝗥𝗶𝘀𝗸 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁
I also target to have lower volatility than US indices, limiting my max drawdown to 15% even during major crisis, and keeping my eToro risk score from 0 to 5.

𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘀𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗲
Relying on a statistical and macroeconomic approach I created, tested with real money and backtesting over 20 years to ensure its consistency even during subprime crisis:
-	I long or short indices with part of my portfolio (generally < 50%) depending on indice variation.
-	I short CBOE VIX with stop-loss and take profit in case of significative increase of volatility.

No minimum copy amount
userDetails.aboutMeShort: My absolute performance and low risk approach is an excellent complement to buy and hold.

userDetails.aboutMe:
Strong companies that pay a regular growing dividend should be a part of every portfolio. These companies shield investors from the wider volatility of the market and the compounding of reinvesting those dividends reaps rewards over the long term.

This portfolio tracks these companies focusing on dividend returns and reinvesting them.
 
I recommend that you copy with at least $500, more if you can afford it. You will need to be copying for at least a month for dividend payments to begin. I will also be depositing a fixed amount (which currently equates ~0.6%) every month. If you can afford to match my contributions then please do so: a $500 copy would require a monthly match of ~$4 - less than the price of a $SBUX !

As an example: If you copied me with $1000 you can expect to add $75 in additional funds over a year and receive approximately $50 in dividends per year (which are reinvested). Once growth is factored in this will leave you with a pot of ~$1300 after a year.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Reliable dividends from reliable companies for long term holding and compounding.

Hello, fellow traders and crypto enthusiasts! 

My name is Jan Bigum Warming and I am a dedicated cryptocurrency investor with a unique strategy. I focus on tracking the five largest cryptocurrencies by market cap, providing a balanced and diversified portfolio that reflects the broader crypto market.

My investment strategy is simple yet effective. I allocate funds based on the market cap of the top5 / top10 cryptocurrencies relative to the entire market cap of all cryptocurrencies listed on coinmarketcap.com. This approach ensures that the portfolio stays in line with the most significant trends in the crypto market.

To maintain this balance, I reallocate funds whenever the ratio has drifted at least 10% away from its target. 

The ratio between the invested capital and the cash reserve is the same as the ratio between the marketcap of the top5 / top10 crypto currencies and the marketcap of all crypto currencies except the top5 / top10 crypto currencies.
userDetails.aboutMeShort:
Tracking top10 cryptos by market cap, monthly rebalancing. 
(remember to copy open trades)

Hi there! I'm Tom. I have been on eToro for 12 years, a Pro Investor since 2020, and hold a CISI Level 3 Certificate in Wealth & Investment Management.

Building on a momentum strategy I’ve run since 2017, this portfolio uses a systematic, multi-factor approach to maximise risk adjusted returns.

My multi factor, rules based process executes a quarterly screen that balances capital across two uncorrelated market premiums:

1. Momentum: Exploiting behavioural biases by capturing the market's strongest structural trends.

2. Quality Value: A more defensive approach, holding highly cash generative, high ROE companies trading at discount.

This is a strictly rules based trading approach, not a buy and hold portfolio. By merging trend following with rigorous fundamental quality filters, the aim is to remove human bias, protect against deep drawdowns, and optimise long-term compounding.

Each month I screen 8,000+ stocks available on eToro, ranking them for momentum, consistency, volatility and downside risk, then applying liquidity, fundamental and diversification checks.

userDetails.aboutMe:
I use the Efficient Frontier to evaluate expected returns, volatility and correlations across equities, bonds, cash and gold.

The goal is to calibrate risk/reward exposure as market conditions and valuations change, rather than predict market tops or chase rallies.

Through systematic allocation and diversification, the portfolio adapts to opportunities. It can become aggressive when expected returns justify greater risk, or defensive when they don’t. The aim is to take the right amount of risk for the opportunities available.

My approach is informed by professional experience in corporate treasury and financial markets, with a focus on disciplined decision-making and long-term compounding.

Minimum copy: $500, typically capturing 80–85% of the portfolio. For a closer match, $1,000 and regular deposits are recommended.

Hello everyone!
 
STRATEGY
I try to find undervalued stocks with good dividends (mostly French ones). Sometimes I can trade commodities (mostly gas or oil) or currencies (mostly eur/usd) if I find good opportunities. I focus on long-term.
 
HOW TO COPY (very important!)
I recommend copying with minimal amount of $500-700 and a minimal perspective of 6 months. Why 6 months? There is a "paradoxal effect": when my portfolio is "on fire", many traders are interested in copying it. BUT at this time there is a very high probability of a pullback; this is normal. This what I call a "breath". So when you start copying my portfolio, I suggest to wait at least 6 months before stopping the copy. Remember, I focus on long term.

I am 44 years old and have been investing since 2009.

Occupation
I am a software engineer, currently in my seventh year working with Microsoft where I lead a team within the Monetization & Business Planning division.

Expectation
My portfolio tends to move in the same direction as the S&P 500 and my strategy aims to maximize gains in rising markets while limiting losses during downturns. In 2022, while the S&P 500 fell 19.44%, my portfolio remained nearly flat, declining just 0.38%.

Diversification
My portfolio is equally weighted across approximately 50 stocks. I invest exclusively in stocks and you will not find other asset types in the portfolio. I buy only companies from the Russell 3000 Index, no shorts, no leverage.

Medium-Term Rotation
Stocks remain in my portfolio for an average of around 10 weeks. Positions are rotated primarily based on earnings estimate revisions, price momentum, and macro events.

Not financial advice. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

userDetails.aboutMe:
DayByDay is the leading European independent research bureau for behavioural analysis since 2000. 
Our unique, proprietary methodology is based on long-term cycles, sentiment analysis, and price triggers identifications. We have been ranked Best Research among worldwide broker panels by Bloomberg and previously AQ Research.
We have developed an Equity selection model that aims at beating the Euro Stoxx 50 in the long term. Our portfolio will be fully invested at all times, and will therefore lose ground when indices do. Yet, thanks to our selection methodology, we aim at minimizing those drawdowns. 
We conduct changes only once a month, on the last trading day, as close as possible to the closing auction price. Our changes do not try to capture short-term moves, but long-term trends. You can implement the changes with us, or you can do it a few days later if you feel you can improve the timing.
All our stocks are Euro-area based.

userDetails.aboutMe:
長線投資，不使用任何槓桿。
It's long-term portfolio without leverage. 
---
This account main strategy is asset allocation with stock ETFs ,bond ETFs and commodity ETFs. The goal of 90% of position keep for growth with low risky. And it will also little position with other product for I follow with interest less than 10%.
---
這是一個長期資產配置部位，追求合理報酬下盡可能低波動，多頭市場不一定會戰勝股市，但即使連續10年空頭，這個投資組合依然能確保資產相對安全、不會有太大跌幅。這個投資組合只適合長期投資者複製追蹤，取得一個相對穩定的投資組合，建議最低持有2年以上。如果你原本就有一些風險較高的配置，需要一部分資金放在穩定投資組合的話，就比較適合複製追蹤這個帳戶。如果是想短線想賺價差的話，那並不適合追蹤複製這個帳戶，因為短線上並不會有太大起伏。
我每2~3個月會投入3000~5000USD到我的帳戶中，這個計畫預計連續執行20年。
主要會以長期持有股票ETF、債券ETF、商品ETF等做資產配置為主，再加上少量一些我想關注的其他類型標的。
因為我不喜歡交易成本，所以不會頻繁進出，控制在低波動風險是這個帳戶的目標。
我追求確定性，但我知道確定性在短期並不會出現，只有長期才可能有足夠有把握的確定性。
操作以我自己訂的量化規則為主，不會有任何一時興起的操作出現在這帳戶。
在資產配置中空頭是必然會遇到的，意外也是必然的，但如果我評估會受的影響不大變不會有特別動作，畢竟資產配置本意就在承受這些波動，在少數情況評估市場風險極高的時候會對部位做出場或避險。
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Long-term stable asset allocation strategy with ETFs. Rebalance regularly.

My investment philosophy is rooted in a GARP (Growth at a Reasonable Price) strategy, a disciplined approach that balances the pursuit of high-growth companies with the valuation rigor of value investing. My goal is to identify businesses with strong earnings potential without overpaying for future performance.

Through over a decade of active market participation, I have learned to navigate the risks of value traps (cheap but declining companies) and growth traps (great companies trading at unsustainable multiples). By blending these styles, I aim to capture upside while mitigating downside risks. 

While quantitative filters help identify opportunities, my final selection is driven by quality. I prioritize companies with durable competitive advantages (moats) capable of sustaining long-term returns.

With a professional background in wealth management for HNWIs, I bring institutional-grade expertise to the eToro community. Join my investing journey and copy my portfolio today.

This account is intended as a long term stable investment (starting: Mar 1, 2021). Dividend paying stocks only. Stocks are chosen mostly from "Dividend Aristocrats" and "Dividend Kings" with a few of my own additions. No money will be added or removed.

I am not a religious scholar. "Halal" status is chosen from Zoya Finance app.

A stock will be removed if:
- Zoya deems the stock "questionable" or "non-compliant",
- Continued very low return (yield + gain) is compared to other stocks (no rush decisions).
I expect both to be rare.
If a stock is removed, a new stock will be added. Total number of stocks will never be less than 50. Dividends are reinvested once cash is 1% of total.

- "Halal" is a personal decision. I trust Zoya Finance right now. Let me know if you have a better alternative.
- Don't expect a lot of trading, most of the stocks will never be sold. This is an investing account, not a trading one.

I follow a hybrid long-term and short-term value investing approach focused on undervalued companies. This means I research companies' intrinsic value and invest if the intrinsic value is significantly lower than the current stock price. I hold shares as long as the company is undervalued which results in both long-term and short-term investments.

In addition to value investing in stocks I also occasionally will do value investing in other asset classes such as indices, currencies and commodoties.

The strategy centers on diversified multi-strategy exposure via broad-based ETFs spanning equities, REITs, fixed income, commodities, and volatility, maintained with zero leverage. This creates a stable, risk-aware portfolio intended to perform consistently across market cycles through a philosophy of diversification and systematic decision-making.

Risk management remains central: positions are sized conservatively and rebalanced methodically to navigate changing conditions without relying on leverage or concentrated bets.

The objective is not to chase market returns but to deliver good risk-adjusted returns over a full market cycle with a minimum time horizon of five years.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Transparent systematic strategy, resilient across cycles, disciplined risk management

أنا هلال عبدالله الجابري، خبير مالي ومحلل فني معتمد، وموثق رسميًا من هيئة الأوراق المالية والسلع في دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة. أعمل في الأسواق المالية وفق منهج احترافي يضع حماية رأس المال والانضباط وإدارة المخاطر في مقدمة الأولويات.
يعتمد أسلوبي في التداول على التحليل الفني المدروس، قراءة الاتجاهات العامة، وتحديد مناطق الدخول والخروج بناءً على معطيات واضحة، بعيدًا عن العشوائية أو القرارات العاطفية. لا أؤمن بالمضاربات عالية المخاطر أو الوعود السريعة، بل أركز على أداء مستقر يمكن الاعتماد عليه على المدى المتوسط والطويل.
أتعامل مع التداول كمسؤولية، ومع أموال المستثمرين كما أتعامل مع أموالي، من خلال خطط واضحة وحدود مخاطر محسوبة وشفافية في التنفيذ. كما أشارك إعلاميًا في التحدث عن الشأن المالي ونشر الوعي الاستثماري ضمن إطار مهني منظم ومتوافق مع الأطر التنظيمية
هدفي من إتاحة النسخ هو تمكين المستثمرين من الاستفادة من خبرتي ضمن بيئة تداول واعية تقوم على الصبر، التخطيط، واحترام رأس المال. النتائج السابقة لا تضمن نتائج مستقبلية، والتداول ينطوي على مخاطر، إلا أن منهجي مبني على الخبرة والالتزام

Investment Strategy (English Version):
A very simple stock/ bond balanced investment and NO leverage. Only Nasdaq and US bond related ETFs are considered. The balanced ratio is frequently adjusted between 8:2~4:6 because of NO etoro commission and NO spread when doing transactions under UK FCA. According to the regression from 2004-now, the CAGR achieves ~10%.  Check "copy open trades" when copying me. Suggested minimal amount, 500USD,  to ensure you can copy all of them when you are doing copy-trading.

投資策略(中文版):
這是一個非常簡單的股債平衡投資且"不"開槓桿，僅考慮Nasdaq跟美國國債相關的ETF。透過etoro的英國監管交易免手續費且無點差交易優點，我會在8:2到4:6之間頻繁調整股債平衡比例。回測2004到現在，數據顯示年化大約10%。複製時勾選"複製開倉交易"的選項，建議金額最少500美金，確保可以複製到所有內容。

====
策略偏穩定跟抗股災，投資時間需要較長，才可以看到成果。

"你怕股災我也很怕!!"
所以在眾多股債ETF內,我挑選了歷史比較悠久的QQQ, VTI 跟TLT，因為這三個ETF可以回測到2007 ~ 2008金融海嘯的表現。圖片有三種股債比例不同的組合(60:40,50:50,40:60)表現也有差異，看完應該會覺得金融海嘯也沒那麼恐怖，眼尖的跟單者也可以看看年化、最差年化，等等表現在各種比例的差異。所以我頻繁的在這些比例中遊走，有點像在一條上升趨勢線上，再求更多一點的回報。

My name is Andrew Collins. My CV includes working in London as a fund manager, but 20 years ago I decided to trade for myself. I have a long term portfolio, but I also manage funds on a short term basis which is what this Etoro account is for. My strategy is relatively simple and I focus on FTSE100 companies, taking advantage of short term price anomalies and movements. My focus is on the more defensive companies which generally have a more predictable earnings stream and share price pattern. My strategy is very effective during times of market volatility and is a good way of diversifying so that you are not just exposed to a long only portfolio. 

For copiers I suggest a minimum of $500 and to copy new trades. My strategy whilst very much short term should be copied for a minimum of twelve months to achieve the full benefit. 

I have taken various qualifications including the Institute of Investment Management and Research Associate Examinations which is now part of the CFA.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Active trading in FTSE100 defensive stocks taking advantage of price anomalies.

【從逆境重啟，到量化統御：Asher Dominion】
> *「以撒在那地耕種，那一年有百倍的收成。耶和華賜福給他，他就昌大，日增月盛。」— 創世記 26:12-13*
> 
**【關於我的傳承與進化】**
歡迎來到我的主頁。我是曾建源，一家重機械公司的負責人。
我對風險的執著，並非誕生於螢幕前的跳動數字，而是來自現實生活的磨難。多年前，我親歷了父親公司破產的危機。在極端逆境中，我被迫深入研究理財與營運邏輯，徹底改革了工廠錯誤的經營方式，最終成功拯救了家族企業。
這份經歷讓我明白：**「錯誤的邏輯會毀滅事業，而絕對的紀律能帶來重生。」**
**📈 十二年的資產實績 (2014 - 2026)：**
我將拯救公司的嚴謹邏輯帶入投資。十二年來，我實現了個人資產淨值從 **10.5 成長至 83.2（增值約 7.92 倍，總報酬 692%）**的戰績。雖然在 2022 年曾因主觀情緒經歷過 **-37.46%** 的挫折，但這再次堅定了我的信念：**投資，必須完全去人性化。**
**🤖 Asher Dominion 的誕生 (2025.12.15 正式上線)：**
為了將救回公司的這份「生存邏輯」自動化，我研發出 **Asher Dominion (統御系統)**。這是我從「數據分析」跨入「全自動量化紀律」的終極解答。
該系統獲三大 AI 評測為 **90 分（專家級）**頂端：
 * **獲利因子 (PF)：** 4.7（追求絕對的高勝算）
 * **回測 MDD：** 12%（旨在確保我們永遠不再經歷毀滅性的回撤）
**🤝 誠信與應許：**
我以基督徒的身份保證，這裡只有真實的數據與實戰淬煉出的盼望。Asher 代表「有福的」，我希望透過這套系統，讓大家擺脫焦慮，享受紀律帶來的祝福。
**🛡️ 給跟單者的操作指南：**
 * 💰 **建議資金：** $500 USD 以上。
 * ⏳ **建議時間：** 至少半年以上，見證量化複利的威力。
 * ✅ **關鍵設定：** 務必勾選「複製開啟中交易」。
userDetails.aboutMeShort: 曾救回破產家業，2014年至今投資淨值增7.9倍。25.12.15為分水嶺，上線Asher Dominion量化引擎。風格：去人性化邏輯、極致控損。數據統御紀律，守護長線複利。

Hallo, ich bin 58 Jahre alt und habe mehr als 20 Jahren Erfahrung mit Aktienhandel. 

Es empfiehlt sich offene Positionen zu Kopieren. Der Mindestkopiebetrag beträgt $500 um alle Positionen zu kopieren, empfohlen ist $1000 oder mehr.

Meine Strategie ist: durch langfristige Positionen, aber auch kurzfristige Trades langfristig ein Vermögen aufzubauen. 

Meine Regeln:
1-2% Investition pro Position und in der Regel max. 5% pro Aktie, max. 10% bei Kryptowährungen. Diversifizierung durch gleichzeitige Investition in Aktien, Grundstoffe und  Devisen um Risiko zu streuen. 

Ich habe das Portfolio bei eToro angelegt um meine Hypothek abbezahlen zu können und deshalb bin ich nicht daran interessiert Geld zu verlieren. Es enthält sowohl konservative, als ach spekulative Positionen. Da ich meinen Wohnsitz in Deutschland habe bin ich auch daran interessiert durch einen gewissen Kryptoanteil Gewinne auch steuerfrei zu erzielen in dem ich die entsprechenden Positionen länger als ein Jahr halte.

userDetails.aboutMe:
I run a rules-based portfolio of US-listed stocks. Target weights follow risk-adjusted price momentum over the prior year, excluding the latest month, with separate entry filters. Higher-ranked stocks get larger targets; this is not an equal-weight or value strategy.

Scores refresh daily. Reviews run Monday and Thursday, but trades depend on drift, turnover and minimum-size rules; turnover is limited to 15% per cycle. The 8% single-stock limit applies to targets, not live holdings: market moves can leave positions above it. There is no fixed holding period.

The stock portfolio is long-only and unleveraged. One separately managed crypto trend position is permitted from time to time. A cash buffer supports trading operations, not an automated hedge.

I track this stock strategy separately from August 2026. Earlier account results include a different leveraged approach. Momentum reversals and correlated holdings can cause substantial losses; diversification does not prevent them.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Rules-based US stock momentum portfolio, long-only, no leverage, weekly reviews.

Dear Investors,

In finance, truth is, less is more!

So, rather than spreading capital thinly across countless holdings, I pursue a concentrated strategy—focusing only on a handful of high-conviction assets positioned for outsized returns. This approach is rooted in two timeless principles: Smith’s invisible hand and Pareto distribution principle, which governs most performance in capital markets.

Over the past two years, this strategy has delivered a total return of 198%—roughly 5× the S&P 500’s 39% gain over the same period.

Sincerely,
Valentin

I'm an economist working as a Financial Controller. I'm a value investor, focusing on analyzing companies as real businesses without leveraging or short-selling.

Decide to invest with me? I can't guarantee quick results. Investing takes time, analysis, and effort, so it's best to have a minimum investment timeframe of five years. ⏳

Every company in my portfolio goes through a thorough review and valuation process, aiming for at least a 30% markup on the market price. I check up on my holdings every six months. The weight of each stock in my portfolio depends on its potential for higher returns. As prices meet the valuation or get updated, the weights in my portfolio change accordingly. 💼💹

To manage risk, I avoid allocating more than 10% of my capital to a single stock. Diversification is key for a balanced and resilient portfolio. 📊💪

So, if you're up for a long-term investing journey that requires careful analysis and dedication, let's make those investments work for us! 🚀🤝

userDetails.aboutMe:
Post-Earnings Announcement Drift is a well-documented market anomaly where stocks tend to continue moving in the direction of an earnings surprise after results are released. This portfolio is designed to systematically capture this effect using a data-driven investment approach.

The strategy focuses on U.S. small-cap stocks within the Russell 2000. A machine-learning model evaluates earnings announcements using factors such as earnings surprises, price and volume reactions, volatility, liquidity, and historical behavior to identify the strongest opportunities.

The portfolio is long-only, entering positions shortly after earnings releases and managing them dynamically through a rotation-based approach. Positions are equally weighted across up to 50 stocks with the highest signals.

Risk management is embedded through position size limits and stop-loss controls to maintain disciplined exposure across market conditions.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Long-only ML strategy capturing post-earnings drift in up to 50 U.S. small-cap stocks.

𝙈𝙮 𝙨𝙩𝙧𝙖𝙩𝙚𝙜𝙮:

I’m an opportunistic investor who seeks out true market extremes and acts only when the risk–reward is unmistakably in my favor. When conviction is high, I build large yet carefully controlled positions; when it isn’t, I wait. My universe is intentionally broad across equities and ETFs, but I steer clear of crypto and leverage. 

I think in long arcs holding periods from a few months to indefinitely with one objective: to outperform the S&P 500 over time through a handful of well-reasoned decisions rather than constant trading. I started investing in 2018, made most of the classic mistakes, and turned those lessons into stronger results in recent years. I hold a BA in Business Administration and work as a regional manager in grocery retail.

I invest 100% of my net worth on eToro, so my incentives are fully aligned with anyone who copies me. Each week I share what I’m researching, planning, and learning. I’m 22 and based in Germany join me for the long journey.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Invest with Philipp Lauer: big positions in market extremes to beat the S&P 500 long term

In the past, I was day trading into highly volatile markets and that did not turn out great for me, however, I've took some months to study intensely and I believe my Dollar-Cost Averaging strategy will prove fruitful in the long run.

👋 Hi! I'm Sara, a neuroscientist investing my own savings here for the long run.

🔬 I treat my portfolio like an experiment: clear hypothesis, data, patience, and honesty when I'm wrong.

🤕 I bought my first crypto at the top of the 2021 bull run (ouch!) and held through the 2022 bear market. Lesson learned.

💻 Engine 1: long-term tech (AI, semiconductors, cloud, cybersecurity), built month after month with DCA.
🪙 Engine 2: crypto, cycle by cycle. I accumulate in bear markets and take profits in bull runs. Entry early, exit early.

🎢 No leverage, no shorts. But expect volatility: drawdowns of 20-30% have happened and will happen again.

⏳ Suggested horizon: 12 months minimum, ideally a full crypto cycle (2-4 years).
💸 Suggested copy: $1,000 (about 90% of my portfolio), $1,500 for a full copy.

📊 Weekly Check-up every Monday, 🔬 Lab Notebook every Wednesday, 📅 Monthly Recap at the start of each month. Every move and every mistake, shared openly.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Neuroscientist with a passion for tech, investing on eToro to achieve financial freedom.

userDetails.aboutMe:
I'm an economist trained at the University of Cambridge and Professor of Economics at the University of Western Australia. I study how economies, markets and human behaviour interact, and I invest through the same lens, building a portfolio that survives bad years and compounds through good ones.

I pursue a long term portfolio with a low risk of 3 to 4. No leverage, no shorting, no forex. Mostly quality stocks, plus commodities and selected debt. Stay invested and let compounding work.

If you copy me, think in years, not weeks. Drawdowns and dull stretches are the design, not a fault. The copiers who held through the 2022 drawdown compounded their capital by 2.6x, turning $1,000 into roughly $2,600. 

I do not suggest tight stop losses; most losses come from dropping out near the bottom, not bad picks. Minimum copy: $1,000, and copy open trades for full alignment. Target: 10 to 15% a year, not a promise.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: I'm a macroeconomist and a value investor. Aim: 10-15% p.a. Risk: 3-4. Copy for 5+ years.

userDetails.aboutMe:
As a dedicated investor with a keen eye on technology and finance landscapes, I specialize in identifying and capitalizing on oligopolistic opportunities within AI and the financial sectors. My portfolio predominantly features industry leaders like NVDA, AMD, TSM, and ASML in the AI hardware space, alongside giants such as MSFT, GOOGL, META, and AMZN in AI software.

Recognizing the importance of stability and risk management, I also strategically invest in dominant players in the traditional economy sector, particularly in finance with stocks like V and MA. This approach not only balances my portfolio but also hedges against the inherent volatility of tech-centric investments.

My investment journey is marked by a methodical approach that combines thorough market analysis, trend monitoring, and a long-term vision. My aim extends beyond financial gain; it's about being at the forefront of technological innovation, contributing to, and benefiting from sectors reshaping our world.

userDetails.aboutMe:
My name is Simon Solbjørg and I live in Norway.

My investment strategy is best explained as a balanced barbell of offence and defence utilizing crypto, equities and commodities.

I achieve offence by deploying my long-short crypto algorithms. They consider trend, momentum and volatility and have thus far performed great. I play defence by allocating towards a diversified set of value assets, both long and sometimes short. 

Since 2015 I have shared my portfolio and investing ideas at www.frihetsfondet.com (Norwegian financial blog). I have invested at eToro since November of 2019 and have great returns to show for it. 

The portfolio will most of the time hold a risk of 3 -6 depending on the market setup. If you want to copy me, you should copy open trades and allocate a minimum of 500 $. Best of luck to you, and please reach out if you have any questions.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Macro, long-short and multi strategy investing utilizing crypto algoriths, gold & ETFs.

Welcome Dear Visitor!

My name is Rodolfo, Engineer, Data Scientist and CFA Level I.

My investment philosophy has evolved toward a simpler, diversified, long-term approach.

Most of my portfolio is in broad index ETFs — S&P 500 (VOO), Nasdaq 100 (QQQM) — plus developed ex-U.S. (VEA) and emerging markets (VWO) for geographic diversification, and a quality/dividend tilt (SCHD). I also hold a small Bitcoin allocation.

I follow a disciplined allocation and rebalance periodically, only trading if a position drifts outside its target band — not reacting to short-term volatility.

I may also dedicate a small portion to individual stocks when I find strong fundamentals, an attractive valuation, and a compelling risk/reward.

My focus: long-term compounding, diversification, low costs, consistency. The goal isn't to beat the S&P 500 — it's to compound steadily alongside it, without the unforced errors that sink most active investors, including, for years, me.

Thanks for visiting!

userDetails.aboutMe:
I don't predict markets. I prepare for them.

Hi, I’m Jesús Domínguez. I’ve been investing since 2009 and on eToro since 2014. MiNumero11 is a long-term strategy focused on capital preservation, disciplined risk management and finding opportunities in changing markets.

I believe protecting capital during difficult periods is as important as participating in strong markets. I combine diversified ETFs and high-quality fixed income with selective equity exposure, adapting to market conditions rather than blindly following them.

I also see fixed income as more than a defensive asset: attractive yields allow me to be paid while waiting and give me flexibility to rebalance towards equities when valuations become more attractive.

My goal is simple: compound wealth over time without taking unnecessary risks. Patience, discipline and preparation are at the heart of MiNumero11.

ich möchte mich Ihnen vorstellen. Schon in den 80er Jahren habe ich die ersten Erfahrungen am Aktienmarkt gemacht.

Nach vielen Jahren täglicher Trades ist es mir gelungen, eine Strategie zu entwickeln, die konstante Rendite bringt.

Beim Trendwechsel nehme ich regelmäßig Gewinne mit und investiere in neue Werte mit Potenzial und Dividenden, kurz vor dem Ex-Tag.
Für mich ist der historischer Zuwachs des Kapitals und die gute Profitabilität wichtiger, als viele offene, nicht realisierte Gewinne und grüne Balken in der Statistik.

Sie können mich schon ab 200$ kopieren.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Heinz Bryzek

Bonjour 👋

Sur eToro depuis fin 𝟮𝟬𝟭𝟳. J'ai commencé par le copy trading, puis je suis passé en gestion directe mi-2018 — et je n'ai plus arrêté.

📊 Mon portefeuille : actions US & FR, ETF et crypto. Je gère seul, sans copier personne, avec un horizon long et très peu de levier.

📉 Où j'en suis, sans filtre : −22,86 % sur 2 ans, 55,6 % de trades gagnants. Le problème n'a jamais été le sens du marché, mais la dispersion — 131 instruments tradés, des lignes trop petites pour compter. Mon chantier actuel : resserrer.

🗣️ Je publie chaque semaine mes mouvements, mes chiffres et mes erreurs. Dans les deux sens.

Si vous envisagez de me copier :
✔️ 𝟱𝟬𝟬 $ minimum pour une synchronisation complète
✔️ Copiez les 𝙤𝙥𝙚𝙣 𝙩𝙧𝙖𝙙𝙚𝙨
✔️ Réglez votre 𝘾𝙎𝙇 selon VOTRE tolérance au risque, pas la mienne. Mes positions peuvent rester longtemps en perte latente.

Je ne promets aucun résultat et je ne donne aucun conseil : je documente mes décisions.

Julien

My trading strategy consists of having more stable and pro value, over pro growth stocks. As the tech heavy sector although can give better returns there is long term sustainability to be considered.
After doing some adjusting to my % of equity in each trade you can now copy me with $750 and have more than 95% of my trades open on your copy. I do still have some smaller positions that would only be opened with $1000 and you would get more out of the copy on day trades. 
The reason why I advise a minimum copy amount is explained on my website. 
www.willscubatrader.com 
I will continue to expand and diversify stocks to reduce exposure to sector corrections in the markets.
I have a mix of long term (months) to slowly increase equity but will invest smaller amounts into potential high earners with tight stop losses to keep the profit ticking over on a weekly/ bi weekly

We develop quantitative, replicable and scalable trading strategies with the aim of generating consistently positive returns over the long term.
 
We have developed our own indicators to identify lucrative signals. They measure price movements, weight them according to strength and duration and determine the current trend. Momentum, seasonality and volatility provide valuable clues. 

The holding period can vary from a few days to several months.

Our expertise is based on training, studies and years of professional experience in the securities business. But nothing can replace trading experience on the stock market with your own money and emotions.

We want to share our insights and experience to create relevant added value for you.

We want to inspire you and wish you much success and joy in investing.

userDetails.aboutMe:
It’s a pleasure to meet you! My name is Francesco, and I’m an Italian investor.

I hold a degree in Law, but my true passion lies in finance. In the field of investment strategy, I also hold a Fitch professional certification, which strengthens my analytical and structured approach.

I focus on high-potential stocks, combined with a mix of ETFs and selected equities for both long-term goals and short-term opportunities, always with careful risk management.

My approach is based on no leverage, broad diversification across countries and sectors, and a medium to long term investment horizon (5–10 years).

I recommend an initial deposit of $1,000, but it’s also possible to start with $200 if paired with a Dollar Cost Averaging (DCA) strategy.

My investment philosophy is long term oriented, with a moderate risk profile, built on discipline, consistency, and trust in the power of compound interest the true engine that transforms patience into exponential growth.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Investor combining high-growth stocks with ETFs, certified Fitch A.R.M.

userDetails.aboutMe:
Popular Investor focused on long-term capital growth with controlled risk.
My goal is to beat the S&P 500 over full cycles by owning the physical and digital choke points of the global economy—not by chasing hype. This is an institutional-grade framework designed for resilience.

FORTRESS (40%): S&P 500, Gold, Berkshire. Our systematic floor.
PHYSICAL (20%): Real-world AI infra. Semiconductors, Uranium, Power.
CORE (20%): High-margin monopolies (Software, Data, Cloud).
HEALTH (10%): Demographic defense & science-backed decorrelation.
ALPHA (10%): Controlled asymmetry (Crypto & Cybersecurity).
	
Every position has a purpose.
Nothing is added for hype. Nothing is held for emotions.

📌 Investment principles:
• Long-term horizon
• No market timing
• Systematic rebalancing
• Trim excess risk, reinforce foundations

This approach is designed for investors who value consistency, resilience, and decision-making quality, especially during volatility.

大家好，我是一位以價值投資為策略的股票市場投資者。我很高興有機會向大家介紹我自己，以及我的投資理念和策略。

作為一名價值投資者，我的目標是尋找低估的股票，並且相信市場價格不一定反映了一家公司的真實價值。我相信公司的基本面和長期潛力是投資成功的關鍵，而不僅僅是短期市場波動。因此，我會花時間研究和分析公司的財務報表、行業趨勢以及競爭優勢等因素，以確定其真實價值。

在我的投資過程中，我堅持著持久的投資觀點，將資金長期投入那些我認為有潛力持續增長的公司。我避免追逐短期熱門股票或者被市場情緒左右的投資決策，而是尋找穩定增長的企業，並且具有強大的商業模式和優秀的管理團隊。

另外，風險管理對我來說非常重要。我會進行充分的風險評估，確保我的投資組合分散化，從而降低單一投資的風險。我也會密切關注市場動態和公司的發展，以及全球經濟環境的變化，並做出相應的調整。

在股票市場上，我相信冷靜和理性是投資成功的關鍵。我會避免情緒驅使的投資決策，並根據充分的研究和分析做出判斷。同時，我也意識到投資是一個學習的過程，我會不斷進一步提升自己的知識和技能，以更好地應對市場的變化和挑戰。

總之，作為一名價值投資者，我追求長期穩定的投資回報，並注重公司的基本面和真實價值。我致力於風險管理和理性決策，並不斷學習和成長。
userDetails.aboutMeShort: 我是一位以價值投資為策略的股市投資者，尋找低估股票並著重長期潛力。堅持持久觀點，避免情緒驅使，重視基本面和風險管理。追求穩定回報，持續學習成長。期待在股市中發掘投資機會。

Hi, I'm James. I'm a seasoned investor, with 10 years' experience of investing in property and stocks.

My aim is to beat the S&P500 every year. Since trading properly on etoro, over the last four years, my return has averaged >50%/year. Although the portfolio has preformed extremely strongly, I'm still very happy with annual returns in the high teens. Anyone saying their target is to average >40% long-term is being unrealistic and, in my view, betraying a lack of understanding about proper risk management. Here be dragons!

I invest mainly in Tech, Renewable Energy, Medical and Defence. I focus on industries which have plenty of room for growth and try to look where the world will be in the next 5-10 years to shape my investment decisions. I believe thinking on a timeframe shorter than this makes you look at investments where potential has already been factored into price, whilst timescales longer than this are too difficult to predict.

Recommended min. copy: $400. Copy open trades.

My strategy on here is generally focusing the majority of my funds on safer long term companies, as well as ETFs, however a small percentage of my funds may be invested into riskier holdings such as crypto.

My goal is to compound capital over the medium to long term and outperform the market over time.

## Income

I invest in cashflow-generating assets that provide a continuous stream of capital.

Dividends are not the destination. They are reinvested into the portfolio as opportunities arise.

**Income creates optionality.**

## Growth

The second part of the portfolio focuses on quality businesses, industrial bottlenecks and selected cyclical exposure.

I look for companies with durable businesses, attractive long-term economics and the ability to benefit from structural or cyclical growth.

Capital is reallocated as opportunities change.

I do not need to predict every macro move.

I need cashflow, good businesses and the discipline to keep capital working.

No leverage. No crypto.

Time horizon: medium to long term.

• 10% Fixed Income
• 25% Alternatives

I use a rules-based momentum system focused on assets showing strong relative strength vs gold. Every buy, hold and sell decision is driven by the system — not gut feel or headlines.

Track record:
2023: +46% | 2024: +25% | 2025: +38% | 2026 YTD: +49%
62% profitable weeks

Strategy:
Long-only, no leverage, 10–20 positions across equities, metals, crypto, bonds and ETFs. Positions capped at 15%. Weekly reviews, no day trading, and comfortable holding cash when momentum disappears.

Risk score 7:
This is a higher-volatility strategy aiming for higher long-term returns. Drawdowns happen. The focus is not avoiding every dip — it is following rules, managing position size, and staying disciplined through cycles.

Best for:
Investors who value discipline, transparency and long-term compounding over short-term excitement.

Weekly updates on all positioning changes.
userBio.aboutMeShort: Systematic momentum vs gold | No leverage | 63% profitable weeks | Rules over emotion

Founder de Gutiérrez Capital Research y creador del método Inevitable Investing, un marco que combina análisis de liquidez, ciclos macro y fundamentales para identificar tendencias inevitables con capacidad estructural de crecimiento.
Gestiono una cartera concentrada, con disciplina absoluta en la gestión del riesgo y horizonte de largo plazo. “Skin in the game”: invierto exclusivamente mi propio capital siguiendo el mismo proceso que comparto en mis informes.
El objetivo es construir un track record transparente, consistente y verificable, aplicando la misma metodología que utilizaría en un vehículo profesional.
Busco negocios con ventajas competitivas sostenibles, modelos resilientes y generación estable de caja. Evito el trading especulativo, el apalancamiento y la rotación innecesaria.
Si decides copiar esta estrategia, ten en cuenta que está diseñada para inversores que valoran la convicción, la paciencia y la claridad a largo plazo.

userDetails.aboutMe:
"Buy low, sell higher, but without being too greedy".

My trading strategy:
-Make cash with oil.
-Buy  stocks that give dividends with this cash.
-Invest in Bitcoin when it gets cheaper.

Quite simple. You are welcome to copy me!

One rool before you copy me:
Do not panic! I open many oil positions with a low SL and I always have a lot of cash to put those SL if the oil price is going lower. I can easily manage a bad 20% red month. And this is when I'm in red that I open many new positions that will give us a lot of cash when the prices go up.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Buy low, sell higher, without being too greedy.

userDetails.aboutMe:
Passionate about the power of long-term investing since 2014, I am a self-made investor dedicated to building freedom through the stock market. Believing in the potential of individual stocks, I navigate the financial world with a focus on sustainability and growth. Investing is not just a strategy for me; it's the best way to secure my future.
Today, I am an accomplished long-term investor with a diverse portfolio. I follow very specific long-term strategies (Warren Buffett is still a huge inspiration for me!). I invest in growth, undervalued companies, that demonstrate the potential to grow over the long-term. I always take the time to do my research and I look through all available data before purchasing shares.  
London-based business leader of 24 years, entrepreneur and accomplished real estate investor. I also use a number of investing platforms outside of Etoro. On top of Etoro, I also use Interactive Brokers, HL co uk, Free Trade and Trading 212

userDetails.aboutMe:
🎯 Swing Trader enfocado en Valor y Crecimiento

Soy analista de datos financieros, especializado en identificar oportunidades en compañías infravaloradas con fundamentos sólidos y crecimiento sostenido. Mi estrategia combina análisis técnico y fundamental para realizar operaciones de mediano plazo, que pueden durar desde algunos meses hasta un par de años, dependiendo de las condiciones del mercado.

📊 Metodología:
Utilizo herramientas de programación y visualización de datos para analizar tendencias clave, manteniendo un nivel de riesgo moderado (4-6) con el fin de equilibrar el crecimiento y la preservación del capital. Mi objetivo es lograr rendimientos anuales del 20% ajustando estratégicamente las posiciones en función del mercado y aprovechando insights relevantes.

🔍 Experiencia:
Desde 2018 he desarrollado experiencia en la gestión de un portafolio diversificado, enfocado en maximizar el potencial de empresas de alto valor y tomar decisiones de inversión basadas en datos.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Swing trade en grandes compañías a buenos precios mediante análisis técnico y fundamental.

userDetails.aboutMe:
Macro-driven, multi-asset investor focused on risk control and long-term compounding.

I invest in commodities and ETFs built around one core thesis: we're in the early stages of a commodities super cycle. Copper, silver, gold, platinum, oil which is all driven by electrification, energy demand, and years of underinvestment in new supply.

Investing is a continuous balancing act between fear and greed :)

I hold a long-term portfolio with a focus on tech stocks.

I pick the technology leaders and I bet on that they will surprise the market.

Semiconductors are close to my mindset: I am a tech fan, I graduated in physics and I like the history of computers.

𝙎𝙘𝙚𝙣𝙖𝙧𝙞𝙤𝙨 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙘𝙤𝙥𝙮𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙢𝙮 𝙥𝙤𝙧𝙩𝙛𝙤𝙡𝙞𝙤:
1) deposit $1000 and forget about it for 0.5Y
2) deposit $200 first and then $50 for several consecutive months

𝘾𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙚𝙣𝙩 𝙩𝙤 𝙥𝙤𝙞𝙣𝙩 𝟭) You probably won't buy the dip. There could be a drop after you enter. Just relax and wait few months. It's tested on my friends.

Also with copy trading you can 𝙁𝙊𝙈𝙊 buy high and in 𝙋𝘼𝙉𝙄𝘾 sell low, so be careful please.

🚀 tech stocks

userDetails.aboutMe:
Hi my name is Peta, I'm a long term investor, I was first introduce to eToro by Jay Smith, we worked together at a gaming events company in the UK. 

I’m a BIG believer in diversifying your portfolio, but having said that the big bad bear could hit both the stocks and the crypto markets. 

I rarely cash out on my trades, some of them have been in my portfolio since 2019! I have sold when things have got in the red and I just want to be done with the stock.

userDetails.aboutMe:
Systematic all-weather book — the low-correlation stabilizer for an equity-heavy basket.

Seven uncorrelated sleeves: managed futures, minimum-volatility equity, gold, international bonds, cash. Unlevered. No crypto. No market timing. No discretionary tilts — the structure is fixed and fully visible.

Risk Score 3 · modeled max drawdown <15% · ~60% winning months · Sortino 0.81 · Calmar 0.91

The trade-off, stated plainly: targets ~7–8% annually at roughly a quarter of the S&P's drawdown. No 30% years. No −40% years. The 36% managed-futures sleeve (DBMF + KMLM) is built to gain when equities trend down — active crisis alpha, not passive ballast.

Formal training in Investment & Portfolio Management, Rice University.
Won't top the return leaderboard. Built to be the ~20% of your portfolio still standing — and compounding — when the rest is digging out of a hole.

- $1000+ recommended.
- Copy Open Trades on.
- 12–24 month minimum horizon.

Sono un investitore che segue i principi del portafoglio All Weather di Ray Dalio, un approccio che mira a bilanciare rischio e rendimento in modo efficiente, indipendentemente dalle condizioni di mercato. Il mio obiettivo principale è preservare il capitale e generare una crescita sostenibile nel lungo termine. 

La mia strategia si basa sulla diversificazione in diverse classi di asset, tra cui azioni globali, obbligazioni governative, materie prime e oro. Credo che una gestione del rischio solida sia più importante della ricerca del rendimento a breve termine, e lascio che il tempo e la capitalizzazione facciano la loro magia.

Se sei alla ricerca di un approccio disciplinato e basato sui dati, che metta al primo posto la protezione del capitale e il rendimento aggiustato per il rischio, sei nel posto giusto. userDetails.aboutMe:
I invest with the goal of growing wealth through a disciplined, long-term approach.

My portfolio combines high-quality businesses, diversified ETFs and selective asymmetric opportunities where the long-term risk/reward is compelling.

I focus on companies with durable competitive advantages, strong free cash flow, healthy balance sheets and sensible valuations. Rather than chasing market trends, I look for opportunities where market pessimism creates attractive valuations and where fundamentals support long-term value creation.

I may trim positions when optimism becomes excessive, while maintaining a strong focus on diversification, capital preservation and risk management.

My approach is patient and fundamentally driven, with the aim of allowing long-term compounding to do the heavy lifting.

All investing involves risk, and past performance is not indicative of future results.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Buy fear. Trim euphoria. Let compounding do the heavy lifting.

userDetails.aboutMe:
A value-oriented investor, seeking out assets that are undervalued by the market, but with strong fundamentals that suggest they will increase in value over time. We focus on distressed assets, mainly equities, which we believe offer a margin of safety and potential for higher returns.

Our understanding of risk and managing it proactively is not entirely based on price movements of the asset, rather than simply reacting to market conditions on any given day, the portfolio is diversified across several holdings with the expectation to hold the security for a number of years until the markets fairly reflect what we consider to be a fair value or our fundamental thesis changes.

Our philosophy can be characterized by a focus on risk management, value, and patience, with an emphasis on contrarian thinking and a long-term perspective.

Background
I am the co-owner of an established Dutch-based metal trading company, where I manage contracts, markets, and long-term business relationships on a daily basis. This hands-on experience in real-world trade has given me a deep understanding of value, risk management, and sustainable growth. My approach is further strengthened by academic studies in Political Science and Psychology at the University of Amsterdam, which sharpened my analytical and strategic thinking.

Strategy

- Best practice: Add funds monthly to benefit from cost averaging

-Rectangle

-H&S Bottom, top and continiuation

-Cup and handle

-Acsending and Descending triangles

Theese are all part of the classical charting principals of Edwards and Magee from the early 1900s. Theese patterns i seek have been around as long as the stock market has and gives a good indicator and entry point with set targets and stop losses.

I do not reccomend any stocks, i simply evaluate charts regardless of the stock to seek profit in the market.

My approach is built on experience, with a strong focus on discipline, risk management and long-term compounding over short-term speculation.

Portfolio framework:
• Equities: 50–80%
• Cash / short-term fixed income: up to 20% (always yielding)
• Commodities: up to 25%

Dynamic allocation based on macro, valuations and risk asymmetry.

Maximise Sharpe ratio and risk-adjusted returns, protect capital and reduce drawdowns while compounding over time.

Not always fully invested. Liquidity is a strategic tool to manage risk and capture opportunities.

Fit:
Long-term, disciplined investors.

Not fit:
Short-term focus, constant trading expectations, aggressive positioning or return chasing.

I am @SavingKing (Line) from Taiwan. Buy Right. Hold Tight. It is my belief. Less is more. Simple is powerful. My allocation is 100% pure stock ETFs for long long long very long term investment . Never bond ETFs. Never rebalance for lowest fee.1/3 US stocks (VTI+VTV).1/3 EAFE (VEA+VGK). 1/3 Emerging Markets(VWO).
Blog: https://savingking.com.tw/blog/post/etoro
FB: https://m.facebook.com/hammer0925/
1/3美國股市: VTI(美國全市場)+VTV(美國價值股),
偏重美國價值股
1/3美國除外成熟市場(歐洲+太平洋):
VEA(歐.遠東.紐澳)+VGK(歐),
偏重VGK歐洲市場,為何偏重歐洲呢?
因為歷史資料顯示太平洋區域
呈現波動風險較高,報酬率卻較低的趨勢
1/3新興市場: VWO
    從2008年以來,大概只有美國一枝獨秀,一貫的投資策略,就是續期投資會加重報酬率較差的市場,這樣的做法已經融入再平衡的理念,甚至是over balance,不用每年刻意花費成本去執行再平衡,依據均值回歸，長期報酬率相近的不同區域股市,做over  balance有機會提高報酬率並降低波動度,若偏離以上三區域各1/3的話,那就是加重了近期表現較差的市場,不論比例如何變化,都不脫全世界股市的範圍,etoro評價我的資產配置,風險等級為3 (最高10)
    絕對不會投資債券ETF,我們正經歷一個大降息年代,短年期美國政府公債ETF IEI (3~7年),殖利率已經低於美金定存,國際政府公債ETF BWX則0利率,甚至還有負利率的歐洲,日本債券,殖利率稍高的美國投資級債券ETF BND也不過2.5%,扣完30%稅跟總開銷比例,預期報酬率僅1.7%,更不用說還要額外的外扣費用,如: etoro點差,匯費...該善用定存,儲蓄險等工具,取代債券配置,更莫忘流動現金才是比股/債更重要的資產

userDetails.aboutMe:
👋 Alexander Tapia | CFA Level II candidate · MSc Data Science 

🎯 What I do
I invest in growth companies when the market sells them for reasons that don’t match their fundamentals. I look for dislocations where the price falls, the business keeps executing and the risk/reward turns asymmetric.

🧠 How I decide
Macro first: rates, liquidity, inflation and credit conditions tell me how much risk the market can absorb and which companies are exposed to financing costs. Then fundamentals: growth that is visible in the numbers, cash generation, balance sheet and the funding behind it. I add when the evidence improves while the price falls, and I take profits when the price runs ahead of it.

⚠️ Risk, said plainly
Long-only, no leverage, no shorts. Buying dislocations means buying before the recovery, so drawdowns happen and the portfolio is concentrated. That is why I think of copying as a 12-month minimum, not a short-term bet.
userDetails.aboutMeShort: Growth stocks & dislocations. Macro + fundamentals. Long-only, no leverage. 12 M+ horizon

userDetails.aboutMe:
Stock market: I draw inspiration from Benjamin Graham, targeting undervalued companies with solid fundamentals. I dive into their financials and prospects, aiming to pick stocks that are priced below their true value. My portfolio gets a regular check-up, usually every quarter, to ensure it stays aligned with my goals, making adjustments as needed.

Crypto: My strategy revolves around the Stock-to-Flow model, particularly during the critical periods surrounding Bitcoin halvings. I primarily focus on Bitcoin and Ethereum, strategizing my investments to leverage the -6m/+18m window. When this period opens and the comparative opportunity cost against the stock market justifies it, I shift my focus more towards crypto to capitalize on the higher return potential.
===============================
If you're considering copying my portfolio:
- Align with my strategy by copying my current investments.
- A minimum investment of $1000 is advisable to effectively mirror my portfolio's performance.

我是一位以「長期投資＋比例配置」為核心的投資人，目標很單純：用可理解、可追蹤、可重複的方式，把時間的力量變成資產成長的引擎。我不追逐短線話題，也不靠情緒交易；我相信真正能讓人走得遠的，是一套在市場多空都站得住腳的結構與紀律。

目前的配置邏輯很清楚：以 AOA 作為核心骨架，讓投資組合自帶股債配置與全球分散的底盤；再用 VT.US 補上全球市場廣度，用 EZU 針對成熟市場區域做分散強化；成長引擎則聚焦在具備長期護城河與現金流能力的科技龍頭——NVDA、GOOGL、MSFT、AMZN，用「有限比例」參與科技趨勢的長週期紅利；最後用 BTC 作為進攻與非傳統資產的一席之地，讓組合在不同金融環境下多一種可能性，但同樣以比例管理風險，不把波動當賭注。

我在意的不是每天的漲跌，而是：組合是否仍符合原本的結構？風險是否仍在可承受範圍？長期假設是否被事實推翻？因此我會固定產出週期性報告，公開透明地記錄：各資產權重變化、組合整體表現與波動特徵、以及我對市場環境的觀察——不是喊單，而是把投資變成一門「可以被檢驗的長期工程」。

如果你也厭倦了追高殺低、想用更穩健的方式參與市場，那我們的路線可能相同：用分散打底、用比例控風險、用時間換成果。市場會吵，但紀律不必跟著吵；我做的，就是把投資這件事，做成一條能走十年、二十年的路。

進入美股市場，經過幾年的反覆試驗投資策略，近來以超過 200% 的兩年回報 驚艷市場，專注於高成長科技與指數策略，並搭配技術分析，為投資組合創造了 125.52%的累積收益！

在瞬息萬變的股市中，如何在高波動中穩步增長資產？
我會使用基本面分析及產業消息來挑選股票，同時使用一些技術分析來設定進入/退出部位。除了尋找被低估的股票外，亦搭配動能趨勢來追求短期獲利。
我的持倉期限是短中長期皆有，核心持股期限會超過12個月，衛星持股期限則為數天至12個月。

多樣化的資產配置：涵蓋科技、成長型個股與槓桿ETF，分散風險，並追求獲利最大化。

精準選股策略：把握科技創新與指數市場趨勢，透過產業消息與技術分析抓住機遇。

穩健長期增長：回報數據四年，證明策略的成功性，2024年達到驚人的 92.17% 回報！


現在加入我，讓我們一起在股市中贏得更高回報。建議最少跟單金額$400，最佳為$1000以獲取最好的報酬率。

userDetails.aboutMe:
Hi all, I am Tung Jie from Malaysia. I am a Software Developer. I use my active income to generate passive income. 

Recommend copy me with minimum 500 USD with open trade.

Here is my strategy in trading. I always "Play Safe". I will invest long term and mid-long terms. 

For long term stock, i will investigate the company background, finance status and future grow before I do trade. For example, Facebook and Apple which i think is the stock for long term invest. 

For Mid-long terms, my holding can be a week to a few months. Unlike Long term stock, I will be more sensive to choose my mid-long terms stock. I will be alerted for the news that impact to my mid-term stock. Also, I will utilise some of the technic such as VCP, bollinger band, MA, RSI etc to buy/sell mid-term stock. 

My goal is to have at least 25% return per year.

As i work in IT field, my first choice of stock will be Technology stock. However, I will buy some other area stock if it is a potential stock.

Those who have been copying and following me will have noticed that I have dropped my position as a Champion PI. I’ve taken this action as the restrictions eToro has in place to maintain this position are too restrictive on my need to navigate the volatility of the markets thus far in 2025.

My investment strategy is currently fluid and high risk for new copiers, my current copiers know how I trade and don’t panic easily and I owe it them to take every step possible to help them recover any loses they may have encountered in April 2025.

Good Luck.

Dear investors,
